title: Roblox Record
features:
THIS IS MY SCRIPT! DO NOT STEAL ANY CODE.
Roblox Record is a client sided replay script that records the movement and appearance of objects in the current roblox session. it captures parts and character models while you play, then lets you view the recording afterward through a simple replay bar.

It records player/NPC body parts individually, so characters can move naturally during playback. Character appearance such as clothing, accessories, body colors, meshes, and SurfaceAppearance is preserved. The replay also detects when recorded parts are removed, so they disappear at the correct point in the replay.

The recording is currently limited to 180 seconds and captures at 15 FPS. Replay playback supports different speeds and a freecam for moving around the recorded scene.

Shortcuts

Space: Play / pause the replay
T: Restart the replay
F: Focus on your player
R: Reset the freecam
W A S D: Move the freecam
Q / E: Move down / up
RMB: Look around
MMB: Pan the camera
Shift: Move faster
Ctrl: Move slower
1 / 2 / 4 / 8: Change playback speed
[ / ]: Move backward / forward 0.5 seconds
Home / End: Go to the start / end of the replay

↑ Up: Rotate the camera up
↓ Down: Rotate the camera down
← Left: Move the camera left
→ Right: Move the camera right
